FrozenMarsh_Text_Npc0.en: The marsh froze twenty years ago.\nIt never thawed.
FrozenMarsh_Text_Npc0.fr: Le marais a gelé il y a vingt ans.\nIl n'a jamais dégelé.

FrozenMarsh_Text_Npc1.en: DEWGONG sleeps on the ice. Do not\nwake it.
FrozenMarsh_Text_Npc1.fr: LAMANTINE dort sur la glace. Ne le\nréveille pas.

FrozenMarsh_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: A PEARL for my wife. A NEVER-MELT\nICE for you.
FrozenMarsh_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Une PERLE pour ma femme. Une GLACE\nÉTERNELLE pour toi.

FrozenMarsh_Text_Quest0_Done.en: She will smile. Take this NEVER-\nMELT ICE.

FrozenMarsh_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
FrozenMarsh_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

FrozenMarsh_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

FrozenMarsh_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.

FrozenMarsh_Text_TopazeFindFull.en: Something shines here, but your BAG\nis full.
FrozenMarsh_Text_TopazeFindFull.fr: Y a un truc qui brille ici, mais\nton SAC est plein.
